### Changed
- **`llmRouting.modelCatalog` is an overlay over the gateway's built-in price catalog** (giantswarm/giantswarm#37975). The agentgateway data plane loads the catalog its release embeds as the base and merges the chart's ConfigMap over it per model and per rate. The block now lists only `anthropic/claude-opus-5-5` and `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5`, which gateway 2.1.2 does not price. The seven other Anthropic entries equalled the built-in prices and are gone. With no entries the chart renders no ConfigMap and no `modelCatalog` source. `make verify-model-catalog` fails when an overlay entry is already priced by the pinned gateway release, so the bump to a release that prices a model drops its entry. The values schema no longer closes a provider to the models the defaults name, so an installation can add one to `anthropic` or add another provider. Each provider is checked against the catalog's shape instead: `models`, and per model `rates` (decimal strings for `input`, `output`, `cacheRead`, `cacheWrite`, `reasoning`, `inputAudio`, `outputAudio`, `perPage`), `tiers` (`contextOver` and `rates`) and `tags`, with no other key.
